hero.desc: A dark and challenging roguelike dungeon crawler built on the legacy of Shattered Pixel Dungeon. Featuring 7 hero classes including the Cleric and Rat King, infinite item rarities, specialized bags, and procedurally generated dungeons that will test your skills.
features.title: GAME FEATURES
features.subtitle: What makes Eternity Pixel Dungeon special
features.rarity_desc: From Common to Mythical — 7 rarity tiers with unique drop rates, visual effects, and power scaling. No two runs are the same.
features.bags_desc: Jewelry Box (40 slots for rings & artifacts), Equipment Bag (60 slots for weapons & armor). Keep your loot organized.
features.filter_desc: Configure minimum rarity thresholds and auto-convert junk loot into gold on pick-up. Clean inventory, clean mind.
features.cleric_desc: Brand new divine spellcaster with holy magic, divine abilities, 2 subclasses, and over 30 unique spells. Fully localized in English and Spanish.
features.vault_desc: A challenging bonus floor with new enemies, puzzle rooms, and exclusive loot. Dare you enter The Vault?
features.i18n_desc: 100% localized in English and Spanish with zero missing keys. Easily extensible to other languages.

about.title: ABOUT THE PROJECT
about.desc: Eternity Pixel Dungeon is a community fork of Experienced Pixel Dungeon, which itself builds upon Shattered Pixel Dungeon. Our goal is to expand the experience with new content, quality-of-life improvements, and a deeper itemization system while respecting the spirit of the original game.
